mapper.update: UPDATE sys_job_config SET sync_status = #{syncStatus}, sync_error = #{syncError}, sync_time = #{syncTime}, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND del_flag = 0
UPDATE sys_job_config SET del_flag = 1, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND del_flag = 0

UPDATE sys_job_config SET status = 2, sync_status = 'SYNCED', sync_error = NULL, sync_time = #{syncTime}, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND schedule_type = 'ONCE' AND fire_once_time = #{fireOnceTime} AND timezone = #{timezone} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status IN (0, 1) AND del_flag = 0

UPDATE sys_job_config job INNER JOIN sys_job_log execution ON execution.id = #{executionId} AND execution.job_config_id = job.id AND execution.status = #{status} AND execution.del_flag = 0 SET job.consecutive_failures = CASE WHEN #{status} = 1 THEN 0 ELSE job.consecutive_failures + 1 END, job.last_completion_time = execution.end_time, job.last_completion_execution_id = execution.id, job.update_time = NOW() WHERE job.del_flag = 0 AND #{status} IN (0, 1) AND execution.end_time IS NOT NULL AND ( job.last_completion_time IS NULL OR execution.end_time > job.last_completion_time OR ( execution.end_time = job.last_completion_time AND execution.id > COALESCE(job.last_completion_execution_id, 0) ) )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_job_config job WHERE job.del_flag = 0 AND job.consecutive_failures > 0

SELECT job.id AS job_config_id, job.job_name, job.job_group, job.consecutive_failures, ( SELECT MAX(COALESCE(log.end_time, log.start_time, log.trigger_time)) FROM sys_job_log log WHERE log.job_config_id = job.id AND log.status = 0 AND log.del_flag = 0 ) AS last_failure_time FROM sys_job_config job WHERE job.del_flag = 0 AND job.consecutive_failures > 0 ORDER BY job.consecutive_failures DESC, last_failure_time DESC, job.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.sql: job.id, job.job_name, job.job_group, job.description, job.schedule_type, job.timezone, job.status, job.sync_status, ( SELECT log.status FROM sys_job_log log WHERE log.job_config_id = job.id AND log.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY log.start_time DESC, log.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS last_execution_status, ( SELECT COALESCE(log.start_time, log.trigger_time) FROM sys_job_log log WHERE log.job_config_id = job.id AND log.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY log.start_time DESC, log.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS last_execution_time
